text:
zhang: Heads up — I'm about to open a PR that wires an AWS Capacity Reservation + placement group into the gpu nodepool module. This is for low-latency NVLink runs (p4d/h100). Before I land it want to confirm the iam/secret changes and the kubelet bootstrapping implications.

maria: Nice. Will this force AZ pinning? placement groups are AZ-scoped usually.

zhang: Yes — we add an optional var.az override to the nodepool module and mark the pool as single-AZ when CR is enabled. Default keeps current multi-AZ. I added a note in the module docstring.

alex: How does this interact with spot fallback? If CR capacity is full we still want to fall back to a spot mixed pool in another AZ.

zhang: Plan is: capacity_reservation optional. If present we create a dedicated ASG using the CR ids + a placement group. Autoscaler policy has nodeTemplate taint `dedicated=cr:NoSchedule`. Spot fallback ASG uses tolerations and lower priority. Fallback logic in kube-scheduler/routing is unchanged.

sara: Any IAM changes for node bootstrap? We used ephemeral creds for kubelet to pull from the model bucket. Do we need extra EC2 permissions to attach CR or read CR metadata?

zhang: Nodes don't attach CRs at runtime — CRs reserve capacity at launch. However the TF change creates aws_ec2_capacity_reservation resources and tags them. The operator running TF needs ec2:CreateCapacityReservation, ec2:DescribeCapacityReservations, ec2:DeleteCapacityReservation. The node IAM role needs no extra perms. The service account used by our provisioning bot (ci/cd) needs the create/delete perms.

alex: Can you paste the TF snippet you're planning to push?

zhang: Sure: ```terraform
resource "aws_ec2_capacity_reservation" "gpu_cr" {
  count               = var.enable_capacity_reservation ? 1 : 0
  instance_type       = var.instance_type
  availability_zone   = var.az
  instance_platform   = "Linux/UNIX"
  instance_count      = var.reservation_count
  tags = merge(var.tags, { "redwood:pool" = var.name })
}

module "gpu_node_pool" {
  source                   = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood/gpu-nodepool.git//modules/nodegroup"
  instance_types           = var.instance_types
  capacity_reservation_ids = aws_ec2_capacity_reservation.gpu_cr[*].id
  placement_group          = var.placement_group // optional
}
```

maria: Good. For the kubelet token/secret wiring — does bootstrapping rely on SSM param or secretsmanager? We rotated last month.

zhang: We're still using Secrets Manager for `node-bootstrap-token`. The change: when Terraform creates the CR we also add a tag `redwood:cr-id` so the infra team can find reservations for audits. No change to the bootstrap secret path. BUT we do need to update the CI role policy to allow Tagging/CreateCR.

devops-bot: Reminder: terraform plan step will run in the prisma-ci/gpu-provision pipeline once PR is opened.

alex: We should add a quick kube manifest to ensure workloads land only on CR nodes. Suggest adding nodeSelector + toleration in the inference deployment. Minimal example: ```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        redwood/gpu: "true"
      tolerations:
        - key: "dedicated"
          operator: "Equal"
          value: "cr"
          effect: "NoSchedule"
```

sara: Also add a `preStop` hook to gracefully drain NVLink jobs before EC2 termination. We had a noisy failure when a node was reclaimed.

zhang: Good call. We'll add lifecycle hooks via ASG termination lifecycle + preStop sleep + SIGTERM handling in the container.

kevin: Quick question about monitoring/alerts — do we want CR usage metrics surfaced in Console (per-pool)?

zhang: Yes, adding CR id to node tags means the node exporter can emit `node_tag_redwood_cr_id`. We'll add a grafana panel and an alert: `CR_utilization > 90% for 10m` -> pager. I'll add to the PR checklist.

maria: Who's owning the CI role policy change? I can do the policy PR if you point to the exact actions.

zhang: Thanks — actions needed: `ec2:CreateCapacityReservation`, `ec2:DeleteCapacityReservation`, `ec2:DescribeCapacityReservations`, and `ec2:DescribeInstances` (for tagging check). I'll put the policy snippet in the PR.

alex: Can we avoid AZ drift in autoscaler? If CR is in AZ-a and ASG is AZ-a only, scaler should not try to scale in other AZs for that pool. Make sure nodeTemplate has zone label pinned.

zhang: Yep, module will set `kubernetes.io/hostname` and `topology.kubernetes.io/zone` on node labels via cloud-init, and the ASG subnet mapping pins the AZ.

sara: I'll open a small playbook for CR teardown during decommission — some customers want CR removed quickly after tests.

kevin: LGTM — assign reviewers @maria @alex. When PR lands ping infra-reviews channel. :thumbsup:

zhang: Thanks all. I'll push the branch now and add the CI policy + grafana panel stub. Expect PR in ~30m.
